head: Rooted in Truth: new Bible study app for iPhone with 84 lessons
dek: Rooted in Truth is a $9.99 Bible study app for iPhone and iPad with five courses, 84 lessons and 280 quiz questions, plus the full King James Bible. It came out on 22 November and was #57 among paid Education apps on the US App Store on 25 November.
details: The courses include Bible Foundations, How to Study Scripture and Introduction to Christian Theology, with certificates for each course. Version 2.0 on 25 November added a black-and-gold design, 107 illustrated Bible character biographies and more faith-based support on topics like anxiety, grief and addiction. It also has a prayer journal and devotionals. It's made by Joshua Capilla, a Christian minister; the listing says the courses aren't accredited and the app doesn't replace medical or mental health care.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 16.4 or later), App Store, $9.99
means: If you want structured Bible courses with quizzes instead of a reading plan, this app bundles them with a searchable King James Bible for a one-time price.
todo: Search "Rooted in Truth" in the App Store; the certificates are the app's own, not an accredited qualification.
